category_edits.rationale: Saturate the causal prefix-length feature at 16 observed interactions to emphasize short-history differences while limiting growth on longer histories. Padding remains zero. All four category models use this formula, including inference because the embedded predictor imports NextItNetModel from train.py. Frequency features, learned parameters, backbone, readout, loss and optimizer remain unchanged.

response.change_summary: Replace prefix-length normalization with log1p(min(prefix_length, 16))/log(17), consistently for training and prediction across all four categories.
